snippet.title: Star Defender 4 Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Free: http://www.gamefools.com/pc-games/star-defender-4.html

Star Defender 4 launches you into a new galactic war where humanity depends on your courage, reflexes, and firepower. As a fearless pilot, guide your ship through hostile space packed with strange enemy craft, swarming alien insects, and dangerous zones shaped by black holes. More than 100 breathtaking levels push you deeper into battle, where every wave of attackers brings the threat of destruction closer and every victory keeps the last hope of mankind alive.

The fight intensifies in Star Defender 4 with eight gigantic missions, stronger weapons, and uglier aliens determined to overwhelm the galaxy. Blast through relentless formations, dodge deadly hazards, explore unstable regions, and upgrade your arsenal as the war grows fiercer with each stage. Every mission demands sharper aim and faster reactions as you tear through enemy forces and strike back against the invasion. In the fire of deep space, your ship becomes the shield between humanity and oblivion.
